evidence.description: Import scan in apps/storybook story files
evidence.content:
All story files import from @platform/ui package exports:
- button.stories.tsx: import { Button } from '@platform/ui/components/button'
- card.stories.tsx: import { Button } from '@platform/ui/components/button', import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@platform/ui/components/card'
- checkbox.stories.tsx: import { Checkbox } from '@platform/ui/components/checkbox', import { Label } from '@platform/ui/components/label'
- input.stories.tsx: import { Input } from '@platform/ui/components/input', import { Label } from '@platform/ui/components/label'
No app-local UI imports or deep package internals found.

evidence.description: Shared primitive (Button) story rendering in Storybook

VAL-SB-002.reason: All 4 story files (button, card, checkbox, input) import shared UI components exclusively through @platform/ui public package exports (e.g., @platform/ui/components/button). No deep src/* imports or app-local UI file imports were found. The Button component renders correctly in Storybook.

evidence.content: preview.ts imports '@platform/ui/styles' at the top level, loading the shared global style/token layer. It configures theme globals (light/dark), a decorator that toggles 'dark' class on documentElement, and control matchers for color/date.

evidence.description: Shared primitive story (Button Default) in themed state (light mode)

evidence.content: No console errors found in browser.

VAL-SB-003.reason: preview.ts loads shared global styles via 'import @platform/ui/styles' and configures theme switching via a decorator. The Button story renders with correct styling in light mode, confirming the shared token contract is active. No console errors.

evidence.description: Light theme state - Button Default story
Dark theme state - Button Default story
Root DOM class inspection before and after toggle
evidence.content:
Light mode: iframe documentElement.classList = '' (empty, no dark class)
Dark mode: iframe documentElement.classList = 'dark'
The preview decorator in preview.ts calls document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', theme === 'dark') inside the Storybook preview iframe. Toolbar button changes from 'Light' to 'Dark' label.
No console errors found after theme switching.

VAL-SB-004.reason: Storybook exposes a light/dark theme toggle in the toolbar (addon-themes). Clicking it toggles the 'dark' class on the preview iframe's documentElement. The canvas background visibly changes from white (light) to dark (dark mode). The Button component styling updates accordingly. No console errors during toggle.
